basketball: TV channel and streaming options for November 14
 By Data Skrive Nov. 14, 2026 5:42 am EST Updated Share article 
 A pair of streaking teams meet when the No. 13 Notre Dame Fighting Irish (3-0) host the DePaul Blue Demons (4-0) on Saturday, November 14, 2026 at 1 p.m. ET. The Fighting Irish will put their three-game win streak on the line against the Blue Demons, winners of four straight.
 How to watch DePaul Blue Demons vs. Notre Dame Fighting Irish
 Venue: Colonial Hall
 Time: 1 p.m. ET
 Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) 
 TV: NBC/Peacock
 Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. 
 Stats to know
 On offense, Notre Dame was the 21st-best team in the country (77.1 points per game) last year. On defense, it was 193rd (65.1 points allowed per game).
 Notre Dame made 6.2 3-pointers per game and shot 34.8% from beyond the arc last year, ranking 167th and 34th, respectively, in the nation.
 DePaul scored 62.9 points per game (235th-ranked in college basketball) last season, while giving up 72.3 points per contest (325th-ranked).
 DePaul made 5.9 three-pointers per game (190th-ranked in college basketball) last season, while putting up a 28.9% three-point percentage (269th-ranked).
